title: CharWood
description: Recycle wooden structures into charcoal with balanced smelting recipes.
body:
# CharWood
**CharWood** lets you recycle wooden structures and furniture into charcoal using balanced smelting recipes.

**Features**

- Smelt wooden blocks into charcoal
- Balanced output based on crafting cost
- Supports many vanilla wooden blocks
- Vanilla-friendly progression
- Lightweight and simple

**Supported Blocks**

- Planks
- Stairs
- Slabs
- Fences
- Chests
- Barrels
- Composters
- Doors

Nether wood is intentionally excluded for balance and vanilla consistency.
